content:
The task failed due to a formatting mismatch in the cost-benefit summary report, specifically regarding comma separators in currency values.
The test_summary_requirements failed with an AssertionError because the expected string '-42,908.83' was not found in the generated summary. The output contained '$-42908.83' without the required comma separator for thousands. This occurred during the validation of total_annual_margin_28_day_usd and other currency fields in the summary report.
